title: Rav Bivi bar Bizna
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In a gloss on the Rambam’s introduction to Zera’im and in Sefer Keritut, Leshon Limmudim, they wrote that where it says in [Sanhedrin 17b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.17b.6) “the Neharbelaim teach,” this is Rav Bivi bar Bizna. The text Hyman uses reads Rami bar Berabbi or Berukhi.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli gives Rami bar Berabbi. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=685&lang=en) also cites the Rambam introduction gloss for the alternative Rav Bivi bar Bizna. Hyman additionally reports the reading Berukhi.
